parsed.name: USB设备连通性诊断组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非实体软件组件，用于在实验系统中描述USB设备并执行连接诊断。它主要检查设备是否可见、是否映射为POSIX端口、端口路径是否有效、端口能否打开，以及是否能够进行命令读写，以帮助排查仪器与主机之间的USB连接问题。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component used in laboratory systems to describe USB devices and perform connectivity diagnostics. It checks whether a device is visible, whether it appears as a POSIX port, whether port paths are valid, whether ports can be opened, and whether command read/write is possible, helping troubleshoot USB connections between instruments and host computers.

actions.description: 检查目标USB设备是否被系统识别并可见。
actions.description_en: Check whether the target USB device is detected and visible to the system.

actions.description: 检查目标设备是否在USB集线器枚举中可见。
actions.description_en: Check whether the target device is visible in USB hub enumeration.

actions.description: 执行USB设备与端口的连通性诊断。
actions.description_en: Run connectivity diagnostics for the USB device and its ports.

actions.description: 检查设备是否以POSIX端口形式出现在系统中。
actions.description_en: Check whether the device appears in the system as a POSIX port.

actions.description: 验证POSIX设备路径是否有效。
actions.description_en: Validate whether the POSIX device path is valid.

actions.description: 检查是否能唯一匹配到一个POSIX端口。
actions.description_en: Check whether there is a unique matching POSIX port.

actions.description: 获取或解析对应的BSD设备路径。
actions.description_en: Get or resolve the corresponding BSD device path.

actions.description: 检查BSD设备路径是否与预期匹配。
actions.description_en: Check whether the BSD device path matches the expected value.

actions.description: 检查已识别端口是否可以打开。
actions.description_en: Check whether the identified port can be opened.

actions.description: 检查USB端口是否可以打开。
actions.description_en: Check whether the USB port can be opened.

actions.description: 获取USB端口标识或端口信息。
actions.description_en: Get the USB port identifier or port information.

actions.description: 获取对应的POSIX端口路径或标识。
actions.description_en: Get the corresponding POSIX port path or identifier.

actions.description: 检查POSIX端口是否可以打开。
actions.description_en: Check whether the POSIX port can be opened.

actions.description: 检查是否可通过POSIX端口进行命令读写。
actions.description_en: Check whether commands can be read and written through the POSIX port.

actions.description: 检查是否可通过USB接口进行命令读写。
actions.description_en: Check whether commands can be read and written through the USB interface.
